answer: Stop sybils with an ivory atlas chart: an agent stakes a bond for one atlas region. Each cycle it files an ivory seal, a key-signed chart; verifiers shine a lantern over it, voiding a region whose seal is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 regions at 16x cost each: each seal fits one atlas region and one lantern check, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents chart once and keep rights.
